summary: Tou-hoi Fok worked in Buddhist studies and philosophy. He studied at the New Asia Institute of Advanced Chinese Studies, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and Otani University, later lecturing at The Chinese University of Hong Kong from around 1972 to 1982.

Touraj Daryaee is a scholar in Iranian and Central Asian studies, history, and archaeology. He studied at the University of California, Los Angeles from around 1993 to 1999 and took up a post at the University of California, Irvine around 2007.

Towao Sakaehara is a historian and Japanologist who earned his degrees at Kyoto University. He held posts at Otemon Gakuin University and Osaka City University, and later served as director of the Osaka Museum of History from 2014 to 2020.

Travis L. Smith specializes in Indology and religious studies. He studied at UC Berkeley and Columbia University, working under John Stratton Hawley, Vasudha Dalmia, and Robert and Sally Goldman, and held posts at Barnard College and the University of Florida.
Trent Walker is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. He earned his PhD at the University of California, Berkeley, where he studied under doctoral supervisor Alexander von Rospatt.

Trevor Leggett worked in Buddhist studies, Japanology, and Indology. He studied at King's College London, SOAS, and under Yukio Tani, Hari Prasad Shastri, and Arthur Waley. He headed the BBC Japanese Service (~1946–1970) and lectured for The Buddhist Society.

Trijang Rinpoche was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure. He studied at Gyuto Monastery and under masters including Pabongkhapa Dechen Nyingpo. He served as a teacher at Ganden Shartse Monastery and taught students including Tenzin Gyatso.
Trinle Lhundrub studied under Dilgo Khyentse and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.
Tro Shul Khenpo Jampal Dorjé studied under Shechen Gyaltsab and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
Troy Organ was a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied at the University of Iowa. He held academic posts at Chatham University, Parsons College, the University of Akron, and Ohio University.

Trulshik Rinpoche was a Buddhist and Tibetology scholar. He studied under teachers including Dilgo Khyentse and Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje, and his students included Tenzin Gyatso, Phakchok Rinpoche, and Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche.
Trung Huynh is a scholar in Buddhist studies who completed a PhD at the University of the West under doctoral supervisor Darui Long (attested 2016).

Trungram Gyaltrul is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Karma Shri Nalanda Institute and completed a PhD at Harvard University under Leonard van der Kuijp, later founding the United Trungram Buddhist Foundation and Fellowship.

Trungram Gyalwa Rinpoche specializes in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Karma Shri Nalanda Institute, Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, and Harvard University (PhD 2004), holding visiting posts at the University of Michigan and McGill University (2016).
Tré Khen Zur Lozang Wangchuk studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, Trijang Rinpoche, and Tenzin Gyatso.

Trịnh Xuân Thuận works in religious studies and other fields. He studied at the California Institute of Technology (~1967–1970) and Princeton University (~1970–1974), joining the University of Virginia around 1976.

Tse-fu Kuan is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a doctorate at the University of Oxford in 2004 under Richard Gombrich. He conducted postdoctoral research at National Cheng Kung University and held a post at Yuan Ze University.

Tsenshab Serkong Rinpoche was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied at Ganden Monastery. He held a post at Ganden Jangtse Monastery and taught Tenzin Gyatso, Alexander Berzin, and Thubten Chodron.

Tsering Dhundup Gonkatsang specializes in Tibetology and linguistics. He studied at Panjab University, Tibetan Children's Villages, and the University of Glasgow, later serving as headmaster at Tibetan Children's Villages and teaching Tibetan at the University of Oxford from 2001.
Tsering Gyaltsen is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and under Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje.
